title: Tye's Homebuilt Turbo Ranger Just DESTROYED Its Best Pass EVER + I Broke McFlurry (36psi)

event.name: Private rental test day
event.conditions: hot; track temp ~140 F; improved after sundown; track sprayed later; track 'beat up by big tire cars'

intake.value: stock plastic intake; team has a longer-runner intake that could help it rev

engine.notes: suspected valve issue - lays over hard at higher rpm; low compression sound on cranking

boost_psi.notes: 'setting five' ~22 psi baseline; log showed 5 psi at the hit, 21 psi in 3rd, crept to 27 psi; final pass reached 36 psi unintentionally

two_step_boost.issue: boost kept climbing the longer it sat on the two-step (7-8 psi); changed to a hard stop around 5.5-5.7 psi

transmission.notes: automatic with converter (converter drive pan-rail gasket seep); shift at 6,500 rpm, considered 7,000

rear_end.notes: previously broke a tab off the rear end - fixed

suspension.notes: previously broken front strut - fixed; new front right shock; front shocks loosened 4 clicks ('wheelie mode'); car drives left - anti-roll bar adjustment needed; car 'lays over' when revved out

tires.notes: brand new tires; tire pressure lowered ~1.5 lb (caption 'turn out pound and a half', low confidence)

passes.notes: intended eighth-mile hit, lifted ~850-900 ft and rolled through; setting 5, 3,400 rpm launch
3,600 rpm launch + more boost; knocked tires off
back to 3,400 rpm with spicier tune; made ~18 psi and knocked tires off

passes.est_et: ~7.60-7.70 (crew estimate, no timeslip - timing system false-triggered)
passes.notes: 3,600 rpm launch, new two-step strategy; drove through the quarter; best run feel ever but no slip

failures.cause: 36 psi exceeded limit; pushed coolant out overflow near left turbo, sprayed windshield; radiator hose rock hard; 'half-day job' to fix
low-compression sound; power falls off at high rpm
broken on earlier outing, fixed before this test

targets.fl2k: conservative to avoid the faster class (6.90 class reference)

cars.confidence: high for 1,355 hp, 8.17/4.89 pass, 36 psi and head gasket failure

base_vehicle.notes: homebuilt; street-driven (drove 40 min to work); came straight from Bristol burnout contest; no cage, no race seat or belts yet

engine.notes: loses cam phasing momentarily causing hiccup

transmission.shift_rpm: ~6,200-6,600 actual vs ~7,200 rev limiter (short shifted by ear)

passes.notes: first pass; short shifted; best-ever per title context
better foot-brake launch; small hiccup (cam phasing)

failures.cause: momentary loss of cam phasing causing a hiccup

targets.et: ~9.50 or bottom 9s with a trans brake; 9.70 possible with right launch

tye_ranger.drivetrain: turbo Coyote / TH400 / Holley / foot brake

mechanics: two-step boost creep while held -> tire spin; fix by capping two-step boost
stock head gasket limit around mid-30s psi on Godzilla
foot-brake launch vs trans brake ~0.15-0.2 s 60ft penalty
